route_results.reason: Water abstraction and discharge are environmental authorization and natural-resource-right states; restriction, interruption, remediation and restoration are utility or environmental operating states. Water body, permit class, allocation unit, jurisdiction or lifecycle stage cannot create a new economic primitive.

Route, slot and regulated-capacity allocation is explicit in Campaign179; transport disruption is Campaign203; safety restriction, grounding and return-to-service are Campaign218. Airport, handler, slot class, authority or lifecycle stage is a source, entity-role or cohort rescue.

Campaign166 already freezes recall identity, affected units, corrections and availability; Campaign170 freezes product-quality outcomes; Campaign212, Campaign216 and Campaign219 freeze corrective-action, recall, remedy, withdrawal and release lifecycles. Product, regulator, mandatory status, severity or re-entry stage is a terminal subtype.

Merger conditions, control transfer, integration and divestiture are frozen in Campaign177, while formal measures, correction and supersession clocks are enforcement primitives. Remedy, trustee, jurisdiction, obligation, monitoring interval or release stage is a transaction-and-enforcement combination rather than an independent mechanism.

Campaign279 already closed the same heritage-clearance route as a project-specific statutory permit combined with stop-work, mitigation and resumption. Heritage authority, protected asset class, geography, excavation type or clearance stage cannot reopen Campaign179 and Campaign200 primitives.

Livestock mortality, culling, replacement and restocking are Campaign191 biological-cycle states; outbreaks are Campaign166 incidents; quarantine, corrective action and release are Campaign212 or Campaign215 quality and food-safety states. Species, disease, authority, site or clearance stage is a combined cohort rescue.

Campaign220 explicitly freezes grid-interconnection requests, queues, studies, agreements, congestion, curtailment, outages and restoration; Campaign204 freezes utility interruption and restoration. Technology, dispatch cause, capacity class, geography or stage is an exact source or cohort rescue.

decision.reason: Every frozen route is already covered by immutable terminal environmental, regulated-right, utility, aviation, quality, recall, transaction, enforcement, construction, biological-production or grid primitives. The frozen priority rule therefore stops Campaign282 before formula, direction, provider, fields, rows or values.
decision.next_safe_work: Campaign283 may freeze a new genuinely independent finite concept-only catalog before targeted inventory. It must not rescue any Campaign282 or earlier route with a current snapshot, incomplete coverage, sibling source, entity role, jurisdiction, field, metric, window, threshold or direction.
